state:
Goal `core-time-duration-2-2`, stage 2 (the dossier). `Core\Time\Duration::parse`, `plus`, `seconds`, `toNanoseconds`, `toMicroseconds`, `toMilliseconds` and `toSeconds` have every proof on disk.
The four readers share one Rust test, `duration_readers_truncate_toward_zero_at_every_scale` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs`, and one Novis case, `tests/conformance/core/time-duration-constructors-and-readers-are-one-scale.nvst`, which now carries their `covers:` marker.
Two members still owe every proof: `toString` and `weeks`.
A literal argument to `Duration::parse` is folded at compile time, so a proof that means to call it passes its text through a variable.
